highlights.title: OpenAI has bought AI personal finance startup Hiro
highlights.description: The acquisition indicates a capability that OpenAI is building into ChatGPT: financial planning.

highlights.title: Daniel Moreno-Gama is facing federal charges for attacking Sam Altman’s home and OpenAI’s HQ
highlights.description: Daniel Moreno-Gama is now facing federal charges after allegedly traveling from Texas to California with the intent to kill OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. On April 10th, he was arrested after throwing a Molotov cocktail at OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's home and attempting to break into OpenAI's headquarters. According to prosecutors, at the HQ, "Moreno-Gama attempted to break the glass doors of the building with a chair and stated that he had come to burn down the location and kill anyone inside." highlights.title: Novo Taps OpenAI to Speed Development of New Obesity Drugs
highlights.description: Novo Nordisk A/S will integrate OpenAI’s artificial intelligence across the company to accelerate drug development.

highlights.title: Two suspects have been arrested for allegedly shooting at Sam Altman's house
highlights.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's house may have been the target of a second attack after San Francisco Police Department arrested two suspects for a reported shooting in the Russian Hill neighborhood. The SFPD said in a press release that police officers responded to a "suspicious occurrence of possible shots fired" at around 5:56 AM ET / 2:56 AM PT on Sunday, April 12. SFPD's Special Investigation Division took over the case and have since detained both 25-year-old Amanda Tom and 23-year-old Muhamad Tar

highlights.title: An Amazon warehouse worker died on the job at Oregon facility
highlights.description: Though Amazon has faced issues with warehouse safety, the company said that the death was not work related.

highlights.title: Blackmagic's DaVinci Resolve 21 takes on Adobe Lightroom with a new Photo page
highlights.description: Many creators have already switched from Adobe Premiere to DaVinci Resolve, and now the developer, Blackmagic Design, is going after Lightroom and Photoshop. The Australian company just unveiled DaVinci Resolve 21 in beta at the NAB 2026 broadcast convention with a brand new page called Photo designed to let you do things like crop and color-correct still images. highlights.title: Dope Thief’s Brian Tyree Henry joins upcoming Apple Original Films feature
highlights.description: Apple TV confirmed today that Brian Tyree Henry, who recently starred alongside Wagner Moura (The Secret Agent, Elite Squad) on Dope Thief, is joining a new feature film from Apple Original Films. Here are the details. more…

highlights.title: Digital Realty Plans €2 Billion Data Center Investments in Italy
highlights.description: Data-center operator Digital Realty Trust Inc. plans to invest €2 billion ($2.3 billion) in Italy over the next five years as part of a Mediterranean-focused build-out in Europe.

highlights.title: Nikita Bier says crypto has had a rough year, hints at building something new as X Money launch nears
highlights.description: The head of product's viral one-liner lands weeks before Elon Musk's fiat payments app goes live with a 6% yield and a Visa card

highlights.title: Emerging-Market Profit Forecasts at Record as AI Boom Defies War
highlights.description: Profit forecasts for emerging-market companies are hitting record highs even as the war in Iran shakes global markets, with investors betting on earnings resilience at Asia’s artificial-intelligence powerhouses.
